caption:
“It's anxiety, so it can't be ADHD.” Research suggests it is often both.

Adults with ADHD are more likely than others to also experience anxiety, depression or autism. These conditions overlap and influence each other, so looking for a single answer can miss part of the picture. Australian guidelines ask clinicians to look for other conditions alongside ADHD, not instead of it.

Part of our series, ADHD: the full picture.

Research:
Choi, W.-S., et al. (2022). The prevalence of psychiatric comorbidities in adult ADHD. https://doi.org/10.1371/journal.pone.0277175
Hartman, C. A., et al. (2023). Anxiety, mood, and substance use disorders in adult men and women with and without ADHD. https://doi.org/10.1016/j.neubiorev.2023.105209
Australian ADHD Professionals Association. (2022). Australian evidence-based clinical practice guideline for ADHD. https://adhdguideline.aadpa.com.au/
